items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'James Moody' in a list of musicians ('Kenny Dorham and James Moody and who else was there'), but the interviewee (Big Chief Moore) does not respond to or acknowledge this specific mention, nor does he mention James Moody himself.

ctx.x: Kenny Dorham and James Moody and who else was there -- the drummer, Max Roach. Anyway I had finished my set with Hot Lips Page and Don Byas and there's a bar down the basement under the Salle Pleyel where the Festival was and I'm down there and I'm listening to Sidney Bechet hold that audience spellbound and all the noise that come in there and I'm down there having a beer and I'm talking with Charlie Parker, Charlie was almost in tears when he says to me, 'I can't follow that ole man. Listen to the people…
